text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's debut delights the members
of the
photography team she works with.

However, they see her running as an
accessory to
her modeling career, a
means of improving her
image within the
industry.

This shocks her to no small degree. The
staff
members she's known for so many
years have no
real grasp of how she
feels.

I promise to help her convey her true
feelings
through her running.
